ownership.compose: JVM and nativeJsMain both pass sk_ref_sp(outer) and sk_ref_sp(inner) to SkImageFilters::Compose. Native filter holds native references independently of Kotlin temporary Managed wrapper lifetime.
ownership.builder: JVM and nativeJsMain both construct SkRuntimeShaderBuilder from sk_ref_sp(effect). Closing a cache-owned RuntimeEffect wrapper does not invalidate an active builder.
ownership.runtime_filter: JVM/nativeJsMain pass builder by value/reference into SkImageFilters::RuntimeShader; tests must verify snapshots retain old values after builder mutation/closure.
ownership.wrapper: Managed.close frees wrapper ownership and wrapper cannot be used afterwards. Do not close wrappers still borrowed by Compose; release only internal temporary child wrappers after composed native ownership established.
